name: Wastewander Justice
summary: In Tanaris, the Wastewander hold nearly every well, and Gadgetzan's water supply is at risk. Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle sends you east of town to bring justice to the Wastewander Bandits and Thieves.

sections.title: Justice for the Wells
sections.body: Without access to the wells held by Wastewander nomads, Gadgetzan's water supply will soon run dry. Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle wants you to bring down ten Wastewander Bandits and Thieves east of town. Then you are to report back at once. He has a taste for goblin-style justice.

sections.title: Far From Done
sections.body: Bilgewhizzle is pleased with how quickly you acted. The Wastewander are thinned enough for the company to consider winning back its wells. Yet Bilgewhizzle is far from done with the foul nomads, and he has more in mind.

faq.answer: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle works for the Gadgetzan Water Company in Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Why is the Gadgetzan Water Company going after the Wastewanders?
faq.answer: The Wastewander nomads hold nearly every water well in the desert. Without access to them, Gadgetzan's water supply will run dry.

faq.q: Where are the Wastewander Bandits and Thieves located?
faq.answer: The Wastewander Bandits and Thieves are in the desert east of Gadgetzan.
